packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch + pin updates after CI passes. Dockerfile digest bumps stay manual — a broken base-image digest already broke main once (see commit 513b008). docker-compose and github-actions digests auto-merge via the rule below; those are docs-example pins (no runtime impact) and SHA-pinned actions (broken SHA = action-not-found = CI fail) respectively.

Auto-merge digest bumps for the low-risk managers only: docker-compose (compose.yaml/docker-compose.yml example pins — docs surface, never executed in CI or production) and github-actions (every action is already SHA-pinned, so a stale Renovate cache pointing at a non-existent SHA shows up immediately as action-not-found in the next workflow run). Dockerfile FROM digests are deliberately excluded — those drive every build and have caused breakage before. Per-repo opt-outs (e.g. BeatsCheck's chodeus/chodeus-ops carve-out) still take precedence.
Keep pydantic + pydantic-core in lockstep. pydantic strictly pins pydantic-core in its metadata, so bumping one without the other yields an unresolvable PR.
Docker base images — separate PRs so breakage is isolated
Pin all GitHub Actions to SHAs
